candidates.title: Agentic AI Hackathon: AWS Community Day Bay Area 2026
candidates.evidence:
Agentic AI Hackathon: AWS Community Day Bay Area 2026
AWS Builder Loft
San Francisco, CA
Build an agent that does real work on AWS. Two weeks. One track. Eight teams demo live on stage at AWS Community Day in front of 500+ builders. Up to $3,200 in AWS credits for the winners.
**How it works**
RSVP here, then complete your team registration by September 28 at the link below (every team member registers individually and enters the same team name). Build from September 29 to October 11. The top 8 submissions get a 5-minute live demo slot on October 13 at the AWS Builder Loft in San Francisco, judged on the spot, with winners announced at the closing session.
**Who should join**
Anyone building with Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents SDK, SageMaker, or any other AWS AI service. Teams of 2 to 4. Solo builders welcome; register anyway and we'll match you with a team before September 29.
**The rules in brief**

* Work starts September 29, not before
* At least two AWS services, one of them an AI service
* Public GitHub repo, MIT or Apache 2.0 license
* No production data, PHI, or PII
* You keep your IP

**Submit by October 11, 11:59 PM PT:** public repo, 3-minute demo video, one-page writeup. Submission link goes out in the September 29 start announcement.
**Judging:** technical depth (30%), real-world usefulness (25%), responsible AI (20%), demo and communication (15%), completeness (10%). Judges score all submissions asynchronously on October 12, then re-score the 8 finalists live.
**Prizes:** 1st place gets $500 in AWS credits per team member (up to 4). 2nd place gets $300 per team member (up to 4). All 8 finalists get their demo featured on the AWS Community Bay Area YouTube channel.
**Complete your registration (required, team name goes here):** [https://luma.com/acba26102](https://luma.com/acba26102)
**Full participant guide:** [https://www.aws-aicd.com/hackathon/](https://www.aws-aicd.com/hackathon/)
Finalists must also be registered for AWS Community Day and present in person on October 13.
Questions? Comment on this event or message the organizers. Reply target is 24 hours.

candidates.title: BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
candidates.evidence:
BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
San Francisco
San Francisco, CA
FREE COMMUNITY EVENT
Okay builders, this one is for you 🩵

On October 10th, we’re bringing 30–40 women together in San Francisco during SF Tech Week for Build For Her - a Women’s Social Impact Hackathon.

We’re building around:

🩺 Women’s Health
💸 Economic Mobility
🛡️ Women’s Safety

And! We were just notified that Build For Her was selected for Tech Week’s Hack Week builder track 😆

We’re looking for women across engineering, AI/data, product, design, research, healthcare, fintech, safety/security, policy + social impact.

You do NOT have to be an engineer or have hackathon experience. Good teams need people who understand the problem just as much as the technology.

Alsooo…some of our longtime Glow Girls already know about this but we’ve been quietly building something called RoamHer. You’ll hear a lot more about her soon, but Build For Her is one of the first experiences we’re bringing to life under RoamHer🩵

Oct 10 | San Francisco | 9AM–5PM

Meet other builders + find your team in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/FWy7whDpR

Presented by RoamHer.

https://partiful.com/e/YZxUe2n2J63HD57dVsOA?c=rP1KrfXX

candidates.title: Neighborhood Innovation Hack Night
candidates.evidence:
Neighborhood Innovation Hack Night
525 Market Street
San Francisco, CA
**RSVP required at: [https://c4sf.me/rsvp](https://c4sf.me/rsvp)**

For SF Good Neighbor Week 2026, SF Civic Tech will be meeting **in person** at the **AWS Builder Loft** at **525 Market St** for the **Neighborhood Innovation Hack Night**.

Guest speaker **Adam Hong,** VP of the SOMA West Neighborhood Association and Founder & CTO of Plurality, will be speaking about what he thinks we need in our neighborhoods, with or without technology, to help people find each other and build community.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

Join SF Civic Tech (formerly Code for San Francisco), a grassroots group of volunteers learning and applying our skills with technology, design, research, and more in service of the public good of San Francisco.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*
PLEASE help promote our community by registering ahead of time in Meetup.
To join online: [https://c4sf.me/zoom](https://c4sf.me/zoom)
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

Our weekly "hack nights" offer an opportunity to join the tech community, network, learn about what's going on, and contribute to projects for your passion or portfolio.

Everyone is welcome regardless of your current skillset. If you're unable to attend at this time, you can still join us on slack ([https://c4sf.me/slack](https://c4sf.me/slack)), where you'll find links to current projects and links to project calls.

How it works:

* **6:30**: Zoom opens: Meet and Greet
* **6:45:** Opening announcements
* **6:50**: New Member Orientation
* **7:00 - 9:00**: Work on projects, explore civic issues, and make new connections
* **9:00**: Lights out!

Good to know:

* Join our Slack workspace ([https://c4sf.me/slack](https://c4sf.me/slack)), where we collaborate remotely
* We ask everyone to abide by our Code of Conduct ([https://c4sf.me/code-of-conduct/](https://c4sf.me/code-of-conduct/)). We will not hesitate to remove anyone who does not respect our community norms.
